about: Member values on the generated screens (P-89). The app supplies each bind key through TData: type text as a display string, type series as a list of numbers; kind says what the value is. Without a value (null or TData.unset) the screen shows the example with an "Example" tag; the preview shows the example with no tag. A ":program" segment stands for the programme the screen was opened for. Generated from generator/bindings.py; do not edit.
